article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — Mike Nwoko had 20 points and 10 rebounds and Xavier defeated Texas A&M 88-83 on Wednesday at the Battle 4 Atlantis Signature Series. The Musketeers won despite blowing a double-digit lead in each half. The game started late after a leaky roofed paused the previous game — Virginia vs. Marquette — to be delayed for about 1 1/2 hours. Xavier made seven consecutive shots early in the second half, turning a four-point halftime advantage into a 63-45 lead. Like they had in erasing a double-digit lead in the first half, the Aggies rallied and Jalen Shelley had two dunks in an 11-0 run that got them within 75-74 with five minutes remaining. The Musketeers went back up by five but Texas A&M eventually tied it at 83 on Shelley's 3-pointer with 37 seconds remaining. Xavier took the lead on a free throw by Nwoko with 35 seconds left, Shelley missed a turnaround jumper, and Nwoko made another free throw with 14 seconds left. A steal by Jovan Milicevic wrapped it up with six seconds left. Tru Washington scored 15 points and Gabriel Pozzato 14 for Xavier (6-1). PJ Haggerty scored 18 points, Shelley 16 and Mackenzie Mgbako 13 for Texas A&M (6-1). The Musketeers led 24-20 about nine minutes into the game. The Musketeers stretched their lead through the next six minutes, outscoring the Aggies 16-6 to lead 40-26. Texas A&M trailed 45-33 with about 4 1/2 minutes left before Haggerty scored five points and Josh Irving hit a 3-pointer to get the Aggies within 45-41 at halftime. Xavier is 29-12 against 14 current SEC teams since January of 2008, including the 2022 NIT Championship game win over Texas A&M. Up next The Signature Series is scheduled to conclude on Friday when Xavier takes on Virginia and Texas A&M faces Marquette. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
